D/43 BCA No.21 of 2025
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
 Ms. Stuti Pandey, Advocate for the 
applicant.
 Mr. Siddharth Bisht, AGA for the State.
 The applicant seeks cancellation of the 
bail granted to the respondent no.2 on two 
counts:-
(i) He is not appearing in the court 
below;
(ii) He is extending threat to the 
applicant/victim. 
 Learned counsel for the applicant would 
submit that Non Bailable Warrants have 
already been issued against the 
respondent no.2. 
 If it is so, is not the bail cancellation 
application premature? 
 Learned counsel for the applicant 
would submit that the date fixed in the 
court below is in the month of November, 
2025. 
 List on 04.12.2025.
 
 
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 13.11.2025
Sanjay

D/27 BCA No.21 of 2025
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
 Ms. Stuti Pandey, Advocate for the
applicant. 
 Mr. Siddhartha Bisht, AGA for the State. 
 The Court wanted to know, as to what 
happened in the Sessions Trial No.88 of 2023 
after 18.04.2025? The last order-sheet had 
been filed of 18.04.2025.
 The applicant seeks cancellation of bail, 
but order-sheet reveals that the trial court 
had already issued Non Bailable Warrants 
securing the presence of the applicant.
 Learned counsel for the applicant seeks 
time to file supplementary affidavit, so as to 
place on record the complete order-sheet of 
the case. 
 Let it be so filed.
 List on 24.04.2026. 
 
 
(Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 12.03.2026
Sanjay

37 BCA No. 21 of 2025
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Ms. Stuti Pandey, Advocate for the 
applicant.
Mr. J.S. Virk, D.A.G. for the State.
It is a case of the applicant that the 
respondent no.2 has jumped the bail. He is 
absconding and the non bailable warrants and 
the processes under Sections 82 and 82 of the 
Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 have already 
been issued against him. Therefore, his bail 
may be cancelled.
At this stage, issuance of notice would 
not serve any purpose because coercive 
processes have already been issued against the 
respondent no.2.
List on 17.07.2026. 
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.) 
 21.05.2026
Jitendra
